report.root_cause: Mass spawn of ~386 pigs and ~1900 dropped dirt items near spawn (x -35..35, z -50..8), seen as RCON-run summon commands in the log. I did not identify who or what ran them, and I did not inspect plugins or command blocks.
report.actions: Noticed entities jump from 24 to 2340 and declared an incident. Read the logs and listed pig positions. Ran "kill @e[type=item]" and "kill @e[type=pig,name=!Wilbur]". Item count was still 108 after the first kill, so I ran the item kill again. Entities are back to 24, TPS is 20 and the count has been stable. No restart, no bans, no files changed.
report.residual_risk: The source of the spawning is unknown, so the flood could recur. The item kill removed all dropped items, including any a player had dropped legitimately; I can't tell whether there were any beyond the flood. I assumed the named pig Wilbur was the original pig and spared it. The pig kill was name-based, and the entity count after it matches the baseline of 24.
